faqs.a:
Renewal of an existing license granted pursuant to this chapter may be had by payment
               of the annual licensing fee and filing of a renewal application with the city clerk
               not less than 45 days prior to the date of expiration. The city clerk may, for good
               cause shown, waive the timely filing requirement.
(Code 1981, § 4-17; Ord. No. 3217, § 2, 9-18-1995; Ord. No. 3810, § 1, 6-16-2003)
